name: omnitravel/gtfs
description: Omnitravel's GTFS, under any PHP host: any network that publishes a static GTFS feed, imported into a store of its own (SQLite or MySQL through PDO) - its stops near a point or by name, its lines with their colours and their stops in order, a stop's next departures and arrivals from the feed's calendars - and, where the network publishes GTFS-Realtime, its trip updates (delays, cancellations, skipped stops) laid over them and its vehicles' positions, read from Protocol Buffers by hand.

suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: A store in an SQLite file
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: A store in MySQL or MariaDB
suggest.ext-zip: Reads a feed's archive with ZipArchive (PharData reads it otherwise)
